title: McRun
description:
`hpr mc`: a design flown many times, each flight's inputs scattered at random about the
nominal flight's, and how far its apogee and landing spread.

apogee_m.description: The apogee's spread, m above the site.

design.description: The design and the configuration flown.

dispersion.description:
One standard deviation of each scattered input, as given; zero leaves it at its nominal
value.

export.description: The `--export` file of every flight's draw and outcome, if one was written.

failed.description:
The flights that failed, counted, with why. Each spread counts them as tried with no
value.

flags.description: The operating envelope's flags the flights raise, each with how many raised it.

flown.description: The flights that flew to the ground.

issues.description: The known errors in HPR Sim's drag or stability that the nominal flight meets.

kind.description: What kind of result this is: every figure in it is simulated, none measured.

landing.description: Where the flights landed, as ellipses.

landing_distance_m.description: The spread of the landing's distance from the pad, m.

launch.description: The nominal launch site, rail and wind, which the flights scatter about.

nominal.description: The nominal flight's figures: the flight `hpr sim` flies with the same options.

notes.description: What the flights leave out of the design, and what to make of their numbers.

seed.description:
The run's seed: the same seed, design and options fly the same flights, bit for bit, on
one platform and build.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

trust.description:
The trust note the text form ends with: what the figures are, what HPR Sim's apogee
was checked against, with the committed report's numbers, and what to rely on instead
(decision record ADR-211).

warnings.description: Problems with the inputs that the flights went ahead despite.

oneOf.description: The ejection charge fires this many seconds after burnout.
No ejection charge: the forward closure is plugged.
A `0`: the RASP format means a charge at burnout, but most files mean plugged.

DesignConfiguration.description: A motor configuration of the design file.

flies.description:
Whether `hpr sim` flies it as the file has it, without `--motor`, with the curves this
run read: a motor whose curve wasn't fetched in this run leaves it out.

label.description:
What the text output calls it: its name, or where it has none its motors and delays in
brackets, such as `[H128W-14]`. `--config` takes it, its id, or its place in this list
counting from 1.

name.description: Its name, as the file writes it; often empty.

not_flown.description:
Why it isn't flown as read, in a few words, such as `its motor's curve to fetch`; `None`
when it flies.

oneOf.description: An OpenRocket `.ork` file.
A rocket's JSON (`.json`): a `hpr_design::Rocket` alone.
A document of the HPR design format (`.hpr`).
A design in the HPR design format's zip container (`.hprz`).

EllipseKind.description: What an ellipse about a run's landings holds.

oneOf.description: A share of the landings, were they a normal scatter with the run's mean and covariance.

Where the next flight lands with the ellipse's chance, allowing for the run's spread being
only an estimate.

meta.description:
For a CSV file, the sidecar written beside it, which names the program that wrote it
([`ExportMeta`]); `null` for the other formats, which name it inside.

rows.description: The rows recorded: one every `--interval` seconds and one at every event.

ExportFormat.description: A recording file's format, from its extension.

oneOf.description: `.csv`: a header of column names with their units, then one line per row.
`.parquet`: Apache Parquet.
`.geojson`: the center of mass's path on the Earth.
`.kml`: the same path, for Google Earth.
RASP `.eng`.
RockSim `.rse`.

FlagKind.description:
The flags a flight raises: the operating envelope's (decision records ADR-143 and ADR-179),
and a rocket unstable under power (issue 335), by its static margin or, where it has none, by
its pitching moment.

oneOf.description:
A static margin below zero, in the weakest plane, from the rail exit to apogee or the
first deployment while a motor burns: the rocket is unstable under power, and its apogee is
not a prediction.

A pitch-moment slope C_mα above zero, from the rail exit to apogee or the first
deployment while a motor burns, where HPR Sim can give no static margin: the rocket is
unstable under power, and its apogee is not a prediction. Raised only when
`unstable_under_power` isn't.

Faster than the fastest public flight HPR Sim has been compared with an independent
reference on.

Above 15° more than 1 s after the rail exit and before apogee or the first deployment,
where a 15° angle would give a normal force of at least a fifth of the rocket's weight.
Past Mach 2.5, the core band's top.
Past Mach 3.5, the envelope's top.

InputWarning.description: Something a reader accepted with a caveat, or the design's checks found unusual.

at.description:
Where: in a `.ork` file, a path of element names from the root or a zip entry's name; in a
motor file, its name and line; `design checks` for a check's finding.

message.description: What was found, and how it was read.

IssueKind.description: Which numbers a known issue bears on.

oneOf.description: The drag: the apogee, the top speed, the drift, the flutter margin.
The stability margin and the center of pressure.

The flight's path, through something other than the drag or the margin (a moment, the
damping, the wind): the apogee and the drift.

Kind.description: What kind of result a command printed: the kind every figure in it is.

oneOf.description: From a model of the flight, not measured.
Measured: an altimeter's log, or a weather balloon's sounding.
A weather model's forecast.
A reanalysis: a weather model's fit to past observations, such as ERA5.
Copied from a data file, such as a motor's curve file, or computed from it.

Launch.description: Where and how the rocket was launched.

atmosphere.description: The atmosphere: always `standard`, the 1976 US Standard Atmosphere.

elevation_m.description: The site's elevation above sea level, m.

heading_deg.description: The direction the rail leans toward, clockwise from true north, degrees.

inclination_deg.description: The rail's angle above the horizon, degrees: 90 is vertical.

rail_length_m.description: The rail's length, m, from the rocket's aft end at the start to the rail's top.

wind_from_deg.description: The direction the wind blows from, clockwise from true north, degrees.

wind_speed_m_s.description: The wind's speed, m/s, the same at every height; 0 for calm air.

McDispersion.description: One standard deviation of each input `hpr mc` scatters, in the units of its option.

burn_time_sd_fraction.description: Each motor's burn time, as a fraction of it, at the same impulse.

cg_sd_m.description: Each stage's center of mass along the axis, m.

deployment_lag_sd_s.description: Each recovery device's lag after its trigger, s.

drag_sd_fraction.description: The rocket's zero-lift drag coefficient, as a fraction of it.

impulse_sd_fraction.description: Each motor's total impulse, as a fraction of it, its propellant mass with it.

inclination_sd_deg.description: The rail's angle above the horizon, degrees.

mass_sd_fraction.description: Each stage's mass without motors, as a fraction of it (0.02 is 2%).

wind_from_sd_deg.description: The wind's direction, degrees, about the nominal one.

wind_sd_fraction.description: The wind's speed at every height, as a fraction of it.

McEllipse.description: An ellipse on the ground about a run's landings.

center_east_m.description: Its center, m east of the pad.

center_north_m.description: Its center, m north of the pad.

inside.description: The share of the flights tried that landed inside it, a failed flight counted outside.

level.description:
Its level: the share of a normal scatter it holds, or for the next flight the chance it
lands inside.

major_heading_deg.description: Its long axis's heading, degrees clockwise from north, in `[0, 180)`.

McFailed.description: The flights of a run that failed.

reasons.description: Why, one entry for each distinct reason, in the order each first happened.

McFailedAt.description: Where a flight of a run failed.

oneOf.description: Making its inputs: its draw left one impossible, such as a motor with no impulse.
Flying them: the flight refused them, such as a negative mass, or stopped with an error.

McFailure.description: A reason flights of a run failed.

at.description: Where: making the flight's inputs from its draw, or flying them.

first_index.description: The first such flight's index, from 0: its row in the `--export` file.

McFlag.description: An envelope flag the flights of a run raise.

McLanding.description:
Where a run's flights landed: the part that keeps the nose, the flight itself until a split
with nothing left to burn, and the sustainer after a powered separation.

center_east_m.description: The landings' mean, m east of the pad; `null` with none.

center_north_m.description: The landings' mean, m north of the pad; `null` with none.

ellipses.description:
The 50% and 95% ellipses of the scatter, then the 95% ellipse for the next flight; the
scatter's need two landings, the next flight's three.

McNominal.description: The nominal flight's figures, beside the spreads.

apogee_m.description: Its apogee, m above the site, if it has one.

landing_distance_m.description: Its landing's distance from the pad, m, if it landed.

landing_east_m.description: Its landing, m east of the pad.

landing_north_m.description: Its landing, m north of the pad.

McSpread.description:
How a figure spreads over a run's flights. A failed flight, or one without the figure, counts
as tried with no value; a statistic is `null` when too few flights have one.

standard_deviation.description: The sample standard deviation (`n − 1`), `null` with fewer than two values.

Peak.description: A metric's extreme and when it came.

after_apogee.description:
Whether it came after apogee, in the fall. With no recovery device opened, a peak in the
fall is not a prediction: the fall rests on small-angle aerodynamics far outside their
range.

height_above_ground_m.description: The height above the launch site then, m.

value.description: The value, in the unit the field's name gives.

ReadFrom.description: Where a source's answer was read from.

oneOf.description: A file given on the command line: `--from`, or an ERA5 file.
Fetched now, and saved in the cache.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

oneOf.description: The cache, still fresh.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

oneOf.description: The cache, older than the source keeps a copy fresh: offline, or the fetch failed.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

reason.description: Online, why the fetch failed or its answer was refused.

configuration.description: The id of the motor configuration flown.

configuration_label.description:
What the text output calls it: its name, or where it has none its motors and delays in
brackets, such as `[H128W-14]`. After `--motor`, the file's configuration and the motor
given, such as `[H128W-14] with --motor H54`, or the motor's name where the file has none.

configuration_name.description: Its name, as the file writes it; often empty.

configurations.description:
Every motor configuration the file holds, the one flown among them, before `--motor`
changed any.

file.description: The file's name, without its folder.

name.description: The rocket's name, as the file writes it.

SimIssue.description: A known error in HPR Sim's drag, stability or flight path that the flight meets.

message.description: What the issue means for this flight, with which way its numbers lean.

parts.description:
The ids of the parts whose shape meets the issue's condition; empty for base drag (68)
and friction (18), which every rocket has, for 121 and 172, for a separated part's
(179, 354), and for the wind's (8) and the center of gravity's (219). For 213 the single
pod sets, for 106 the body parts the supersonic join covers.

count.description: How many of it fly: one per tube of a cluster, and one per pod of a pod set.

delay.description: Its ejection delay as the design sets it, if it does; `--motor` sets none.

ignition.description: When it lights, in words: `at launch`, or as the design says.

mount.description: The id of the motor mount it is in, which `--mount` takes, as it takes the mount's name.

mount_name.description: The mount's name, as the file writes it.

unlit.description: How many of those never light: in a tube the design marks failed, or set never to light.

SimMotorSource.description: Where a flown motor comes from.

oneOf.description: The design file's own configuration.
The bundled catalog, named with `--motor`.

as_of.description: The catalog's as-of date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the day its curve files were downloaded.

oneOf.description: A motor file named with `--motor`.

file.description: The file's name, without its folder.

oneOf.description:
A curve fetched from ThrustCurve.org: a `--motor` name the bundled catalog lacks, or a
design's motor with no curve of its own, found by its manufacturer and designation.

ThrustCurveMotor.description:
A motor found on ThrustCurve.org by name, and the curve file HPR Sim flies it by: the first RASP
file that reads, ranked by who measured it (a certification test, the manufacturer, a user),
else the first RockSim file the same way.

common_name.description: The common name, such as `F27`, when ThrustCurve.org gives one.

designation.description: The designation, as ThrustCurve.org spells it, such as `F27R/L`.

file_id.description: ThrustCurve.org's id of the curve file flown.

license.description:
The file's license, as ThrustCurve.org says: `PD` (public domain), `free` or `other`;
`null` when its contributor named none.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer, as ThrustCurve.org names it, such as `AeroTech`.

measured_by.description:
Who measured the curve, as ThrustCurve.org says: `cert` (a certification test), `mfr`
(the manufacturer) or `user`; `null` when it doesn't say.

page.description: The file's page on ThrustCurve.org, when it gives one.

read_from.description: Where the file was read from: fetched now, or the cache.

oneOf.description: A whole motor had an error and was left out.
A value was dropped or ignored.
Something unusual was read as it stands.
